dedupe_keys.name: data underlying the biopa based alpheus case study

description: University of Tuscia and project partners provide CFD inputs and statistical outputs processed with BioPA V3.0. The source states that the material assesses fish friendliness of reversible pump-turbine technologies for low to ultra-low heads of 1 to 20 metres. It identifies ALPHEUS deliverable D2.6 on expected mortality from prototype-scale turbines. Coverage: 2023. Access: public native metadata describes the identified research release. Licence: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0. Current file access and cost are unknown. Related resources have separately identified native releases. Caveats: Source variables, units, field schemas and BioPA assumptions are unstated. Mortality claims, solver execution and input completeness were not independently tested. Its simulation use concerns the specified environmental assessment of pumped-hydro turbine designs.
